triggers.description: Armed security or firearms are carried
Asbestos is present or may be disturbed
A health and safety committee is required
Construction work at or above the notification or permit thresholds (thresholds pinned in Phase 2)
Contractors or mandataries work for the employer
Food is prepared, handled or served
Hazardous chemical agents are used, stored or produced
Hot work such as welding, cutting or grinding
The workforce requires designated health and safety representatives
Machinery that needs guarding and supervision
Holdings of listed substances at or above the major hazard installation thresholds (pinned in Phase 2)
A mine, under the Mine Health and Safety Act regime
Construction vehicles, forklifts or other mobile plant
Noise exposure identified by the risk assessment
Drivers who need a professional driving permit
A permit to work system is needed
Members of the public may be affected by the work
Work on or next to public roads
Task based and daily pre task risk assessments are needed
Waste is generated, handled or disposed of

templates.name: Scaffold register and inspection records

retention.text: As the legal instrument sets it, still being confirmed; until then set by your competent person

templates.description: Scaffold collapses and falls from scaffolds cause serious injuries and deaths. The register proves each scaffold was inspected by your appointed scaffold inspector, and inspected again after bad weather or any change. Hold it at the interval your risk assessment or the practitioner sets; the File library shows a legal interval only once Care Net has verified one.

items.prompt: Scaffold register listing every scaffold by number, location and erection date
Signed inspection records by your appointed scaffold inspector
Handover or tag record showing each scaffold was declared safe before use

items.section_label: Gaps to look for (Pass means not found)
items.prompt: Inspection pages signed by someone who is not the appointed scaffold inspector

items.section_label: Gaps to look for (Pass means not found)
items.prompt: Scaffolds hired in by a subcontractor missing from your register

items.section_label: Gaps to look for (Pass means not found)
items.prompt: No inspection recorded after strong wind or heavy rain

templates.name: Ladder register and inspections
templates.description: Falls from ladders are one of the most common serious injuries in small businesses. The register shows every ladder is inspected and that damaged ones are taken out of service instead of being left for someone to use. Hold it at the interval your risk assessment or the practitioner sets; the File library shows a legal interval only once Care Net has verified one.

items.prompt: Ladder register with a number, type and location for every ladder
Inspection checklist pages signed by your ladder inspector
A note of damaged ladders removed from use and how they were destroyed

items.section_label: Gaps to look for (Pass means not found)
items.prompt: Ladders in the storeroom or vehicles never added to the register

items.section_label: Gaps to look for (Pass means not found)
items.prompt: Damaged ladders marked on the register but still in use

items.section_label: Gaps to look for (Pass means not found)
items.prompt: Homemade or painted over wooden ladders that hide defects

templates.name: Hazardous chemical agent register with safety data sheets, quantities and storage

retention.text: As the legal instrument sets it, still being confirmed; until then set by your competent person

templates.description: You cannot control chemicals you have not listed. The register and safety data sheets tell workers, first aiders and emergency services what each substance does and how to handle a spill or exposure, and they underpin the chemical risk assessment and any medical surveillance under the Hazardous Chemical Agents Regulations. Update it whenever a chemical is added, removed or moved.

items.prompt: Register of every hazardous chemical, with where it is stored and roughly how much you hold
A current safety data sheet for each chemical
Storage inspection records signed by the hazardous chemical agent controller
